title: GPT-6.2 Astra vs. Claude Fable 5.2 hands-on: nearly tied on three custom accounting, coding, and data tasks, but Fable used far more tokens and cost 5x+ as much (Jessica Wachtel/The New Stack)
summary: Jessica Wachtel / The New Stack: GPT-6.2 Astra vs. Claude Fable 5.2 hands-on: nearly tied on three custom accounting, coding, and data tasks, but Fable used far more tokens and cost 5x+ as much — When I compared Anthropic's Fable 5.2 vs. OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra last week, Fable 5.2 was slightly more accurate (149 points vs. 145).
